name: HER Y Necklace
subtitle: 18K Solid Gold · Lab-Grown Diamond Y-Drop
summary: A lab-grown diamond Y-drop necklace in 18K solid gold, with individually set round brilliants and an IGI-certified 3.00 ct oval diamond at the tip.
description:
HER Y traces a 35 cm neckline before falling into a 10 cm diamond drop. Approximately 50 round brilliant lab-grown diamonds are individually prong-set and joined by delicate articulated links. A 3.00 ct oval brilliant lab-grown diamond, graded E colour and VVS2 clarity by IGI, finishes the drop. Available in 18K solid yellow or white gold.

HER Y was created for the woman who understands that her worth is never defined by anyone else.

The graceful Y-shaped silhouette represents her individuality, while the cascading diamonds celebrate her confidence, strength, and beauty.

A piece designed to be worn not simply as jewellery, but as a reflection of the woman wearing it.

For the woman who knows her worth.

Toronto Jewels Curation — Your Jewellery, Your Way.

details.Metal: 18K solid yellow gold or white gold
details.Setting: Individually prong-set diamonds with articulated links
details.Round diamonds: Approx. 50 round brilliant lab-grown diamonds, including those along the drop
details.Round diamond size: Approx. 5.0 mm each; estimated 0.47–0.50 ct (47–50 points) per diamond
details.Oval drop diamond: 3.00 ct oval brilliant lab-grown diamond at the base of the Y-drop
